manifesto: From Roseau to Portsmouth, Dominica thrives on self-reliance and natural ingenuity. Ceyo gives you round-the-clock autonomous cloud computers that run business processes, manage client channels, and build software while you focus on sustainable growth.

uses.d: Connect your bot to booking platforms and WhatsApp to resolve tour queries, check dive availability at Champagne Reef, and manage reservations 24/7.
Automate data collation between local farmers, phyto-sanitary inspection checklists, and regional export manifests using connected Google Sheets.
Deploy browser agents to monitor vessel arrivals at Woodbridge Bay Port, track customs freight paperwork, and alert freight forwarders automatically.
Set daily scheduled routines that crawl weather alerts, environmental research, and maritime forecasts to generate structured morning briefings.
Instruct the cloud coding agent to build and test responsive client websites, booking portals, and interactive tools directly in an isolated container.
Coordinate remote international clients through voice and video calls with agents that draft meeting summaries and update your CRM seamlessly.

steps.d: Choose Plus, Pro, or Ultra to activate your 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 daily tokens.
Spin up dedicated cloud computers equipped with web browsers, developer environments, and app integrations.
Add your bots to individual Telegram chats or group channels to execute automated tasks around the clock.

chapters.d: While you travel into Roseau, your agent scrapes maritime schedules and compiles weather updates into a concise Telegram summary. Your supply team receives verified shipment timelines before office doors open.

Your agent's cloud browser cross-references Caribbean regional trade tariffs and updates your internal pricing models across Notion and Google Sheets. No open tabs clutter your laptop while the machine works autonomously.

Your coding bot tests and executes script updates in its isolated cloud sandbox, refining a new booking calculator for international visitors. The staging site goes live without consuming your phone's battery or local bandwidth.

As you log off for the night, your group of specialized Telegram agents manages overnight hospitality inquiries across international time zones. Daily logs and crypto transactions are reconciled silently in the background.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Dominica?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every tier starts with a 3-day free trial granting up to 1,000,000 tokens per day, with your linked card billed only if not cancelled before the trial ends.

faq.q: Do my AI agents stay active if my power or phone goes off?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer 24/7, meaning routines, site tracking, and coding tasks continue uninterrupted regardless of your device battery or local power connectivity.

faq.q: Which languages do Ceyo agents understand?
faq.a: Ceyo supports major global languages, including English and French, facilitating easy communication with local partners, regional Caribbean neighbors, and international clients.

faq.q: How does Ceyo integrate with Telegram?
faq.a: You can assign bots to individual Telegram chats or create multi-agent group chats where specialist bots collaborate on project tasks, share data, and produce unified deliverables.

faq.q: What apps and tools can Ceyo connect with?
faq.a: Ceyo links seamlessly to over 1,000 everyday applications including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, CRMs, and built-in crypto wallets.
